messages:
elaine_support: Customer flagged an incident after automatic region failover — responses started returning garbled tokens and hallucinated JSON keys. Happens consistently after we route traffic to backup in us-west. Request id: req_0b34f9a2.
elaine_support: Example curl they used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \\n  -d '{"model":"gptx-4","input":"Summarize the invoice: \"Invoice #12345\""}'
```
elaine_support: Response (received after failover):
```json
{"id":"req_0b34f9a2","output":"\\u0000\\u0012�- invoice : #12345 \\n\\u0002\\u0000"}
```
elaine_support: They've attached a full HAR and say latency spiked from 120ms -> 700ms during the failover window. Also noted 20x retry attempts client-side.
ops_bot: Created support ticket #INC-2024-789; assigned to support oncall. :rotating_light:
ops_bot: Linked incident: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2024-789
tim_oncall: Ack, looking. Can you paste router decision header for that request (x-redwood-route / x-redwood-fallback)? Or full proxy logs for req_0b34f9a2.
elaine_support: Pasted headers below: 
```
x-redwood-route: us-east-1-primary
x-redwood-fallback: us-west-2-quantized-pool
x-redwood-model-served: gptx-lite-q4_0
x-redwood-model-requested: gptx-4
```
raj_dev: Thanks. That explains a lot — the runtime selected gptx-lite-q4_0 as a fallback (quantized lite variant). That variant uses a different tokenizer config (bpe-vocab-v2) vs gptx-4 (bpe-vocab-v1). We do not auto-transpile tokenizers.
raj_dev: Quick note: our failover routing is architecture-aware but currently matches on "model family" not tokenizer version. When capacity is tight we pick the smallest compatible checkpoint that runs, which can differ in vocab.
nora_qa: I reproduced locally by forcing the same header route. When serving gptx-lite-q4_0 with an input containing smart quotes and punctuation the tokenization boundary shifts; some tokens become invalid sequences and the post-processing strips them which looks like binary garbage. Repro steps:
1) Force header x-redwood-model-served: gptx-lite-q4_0
2) Send payload with curly quotes and em dashes
3) Observe desynced decoder output
```
# short repro script
python repro.py --model served=gptx-lite-q4_0 --input 'Invoice “#12345” — total $1,234.56'
```
elaine_support: Customer says they never opted into fallback variants and expected model alias pinning to prevent this. They have pins set to gptx-4 in their console.
sarah_pm: Confirming: user's pinned alias should block automatic fallback unless the alias includes allowed substitutes. Did the pin accidentally include an alias group with lite variants?
raj_dev: Checking alias config now. It looks like a misconfigured alias group: alias "gptx-4-stable" had wildcard fallback policy set to ANY_COMPATIBLE for that org, which allowed architecture-compatible quantized variants.
raj_dev: Root cause (prelim): cross-region capacity failover + permissive alias fallback policy -> runtime served quantized lite variant with incompatible tokenizer.
billing_team: BTW because the client retried ~20x during 700ms latency and then we returned unexpected tokens, tokens billed spiked. Noted a 3.2x token spike for that org during the incident window. We should consider a credit if root cause is our routing mistake.
tim_oncall: Short term mitigation: roll traffic for that org back to us-east primary if capacity permits, or set alias fallback policy to NO_SUBSTITUTIONS for their pins. Can eng-runtime do a targeted rollback to force model equality?
raj_dev: I can push a hotfix to enforce tokenizer-compatible fallbacks only (match tokenizer hash) — but need a quick mitigation first. I'll disable ANY_COMPATIBLE fallback for the org and trigger a targeted re-route to primary.
ops_bot: Action created: ENG-ROUTE-245 (urgent). Escalate to runtime team.
ops_bot: Notifying oncall channel #eng-runtime.
raj_dev: @tim_oncall @nora_qa assigning myself. Plan: 1) change org alias fallback to NO_SUBSTITUTIONS (manual) 2) add tokenizer-hash check to fallback matcher (hotfix) 3) add a validation rule in Console so pins warn when alias contains quantized variants. ETA for 1: 15m, ETA for 2: 4-6 hours.
elaine_support: Customer asked for repro they can run to confirm fix. Nora, can you attach a minimal curl that demonstrates the mismatch?
nora_qa: Sent a simplified repro curl (pasted to ticket).
billing_team: I'll draft a goodwill credit proposal pending eng confirmation.
sarah_pm: Please label this P1 for customer-visible regression and provide customer-facing postmortem once resolved.
raj_dev: Will follow up here with the rollback link and the CL for the hotfix.
ops_bot: @raj_dev added to incident and created subtask ENG-4487 for tokenizer compatibility matcher.
elaine_support: Thanks team. Customer is now paused on production traffic until we confirm.
tim_oncall: Keeping channel open; ping me when rollback is pushed. :thumbsup:
